desc: Analyze problem and design algorithm (trie + M[L]/C[L] classification)
Implement trie with integer child indices and count array; insert all words to populate node counts
Compute M[L] (max count at depth L) and C[L] (count of prefixes with count==k) via a trie traversal
Determine L0 (max universal length) and collect special lengths (L > L0 where M[L]==k and C[L]==1)
For each word, walk trie to build Bad[i] (set of special lengths it uniquely owns)
Handle edge cases: if n-1 < k return all zeros; handle k=1 separately
Compute answer per index: start with L0, then scan special lengths (descending) and take the first not in Bad[i]
Verify against given examples and random small brute-force tests
Confirm time complexity O(n + sum|words|) and memory O(sum|words|)
